title: Alert Noise vs Incident Summary
description: Raw Claroty alert events versus grouped (suppressed) detection alerts

data_source.query: FROM logs-claroty_ctd.event-* | WHERE event.kind == "alert" | STATS `Raw Claroty alert events` = COUNT(*)
FROM .alerts-security.alerts-default | WHERE kibana.alert.rule.name == "OT - Claroty CTD alert (suppressed by asset and signature)" | STATS `Grouped alerts` = COUNT(*)

FROM .alerts-security.alerts-default | WHERE kibana.alert.rule.name == "OT - Claroty CTD alert (suppressed by asset and signature)" | STATS `Duplicates suppressed` = SUM(kibana.alert.suppression.docs_count)

config.title: Raw Claroty alert events over time

data_source.query: FROM logs-claroty_ctd.event-* | WHERE event.kind == "alert" | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS raw_events = COUNT(*) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

config.title: Raw events by alert name and destination asset

data_source.query: FROM logs-claroty_ctd.event-* | WHERE event.kind == "alert" | EVAL asset.ip = destination.ip | LOOKUP JOIN ot-assets ON asset.ip | STATS raw_events = COUNT(*) BY claroty_ctd.event.name, asset.name | SORT raw_events DESC | LIMIT 10

config.title: Grouped alerts (one row per asset and signature)

data_source.query: FROM .alerts-security.alerts-default | WHERE kibana.alert.rule.name == "OT - Claroty CTD alert (suppressed by asset and signature)" | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 20 | KEEP @timestamp, kibana.alert.suppression.terms.value, kibana.alert.suppression.docs_count, kibana.alert.severity, kibana.alert.workflow_status
